title: AI-answer visibility
description: Assess observed AI mentions/citations and factual representation, implement requested improvements, and independently check claims.
intent: Complete the requested GEO assessment or scoped changes from actual observed/provided evidence. Distinguish platform-specific behavior, variable samples, hypotheses, and measured results; no inclusion guarantee or unrequested external testing.

assignments.task: Define prompts/platforms/locale, inspect authorized actual observations or provided results, and record sampling/access gaps.
Assess relevant shared crawl/index/content foundations and current technical requirements.
Gather authoritative current platform rules and supporting public sources.
assignments.when: Current or niche platform facts need verification.

assignments.task: Review identity/positioning consistency against approved public facts.
assignments.when: Public identity or messaging gaps affect the requested assessment.

assignments.task: Return requested supported content drafts addressing representation/source gaps.
Assess available sampling, denominators, repeated observations, and comparable measurement conditions.
assignments.when: Quantitative visibility comparisons or outcome rates are requested.

assignments.task: Implement only requested public-source/content changes with relevant checks; disclose no private project information.
Review completed deliverable; repeat measurements only within actual authorization/access and mark unavailable post-change evidence.
Check completed citations, representation claims, numerical denominators, freshness, and causal-inference limits.

completion: The scope, actual observations, platform conditions, citations, and access gaps are reported.
New evidence/content is checked after completion; unsupported causal or guaranteed-visibility claims are excluded.
Private data, external query/spend, account, and publication boundaries follow task authority.
